insert_index.description: Position in the layout order at which the new layouts are placed. They are appended after the last layout when omitted.

layouts.description: Master layouts to insert, from 1 to 50 in a single call. Each has to name the layout kind it creates. Mandatory.

layout.description: Which layout kind to create, together with the arrangement of its regions. Mandatory on insert.

titleTwoContentImage.description: Layout holding a title, two content regions and an image. Set exactly one layout key.

comparison.description: Layout setting two content regions side by side for comparison. Set exactly one layout key.

blank.description: Blank layout. BlankLayout declares no fields, so send an empty object: {}.

titleSubTitleImage.description: Layout holding a title, a subtitle and an image. Set exactly one layout key.

titleFourContent.description: Layout holding a title and four content regions. Set exactly one layout key.

titleThreeContentImage.description: Layout holding a title, three content regions and an image. Set exactly one layout key.

titleSubTitle.description: Layout holding a title and a subtitle. Set exactly one layout key.

titleTwoContent.description: Layout holding a title and two content regions. Set exactly one layout key.

titleImage.description: Layout holding a title and an image. Set exactly one layout key.

titleOnly.description: Title-only layout. TitleOnlyLayout declares no fields, so send an empty object: {}.

titleContent.description: Layout holding a title and one content region. Set exactly one layout key.

titleContentImageCaption.description: Layout holding a title, a content region, and an image with a caption. Set exactly one layout key.

titleTwoContentTwoImage.description: Layout holding a title, two content regions and two images. Set exactly one layout key.

titleThreeContent.description: Layout holding a title and three content regions. Set exactly one layout key.

titleThreeContentThreeImage.description: Layout holding a title, three content regions and three images. Set exactly one layout key.

graphic_objects.description: Objects to place on the new layout, such as placeholders and guides, up to 500.

background.description: Fill painted behind the objects of every slide using this layout, overriding the master's background. Omit it to inherit the master's; no_fill overrides that with nothing.

name.description: Display name for the new master layout, up to 500 characters.

layouts.description: Layout updates, from 1 to 50 in a single call. Each entry has to carry the id of the layout it updates. Mandatory.

layout.description: Layout kind and region arrangement to apply. The existing layout kind is kept when omitted.

titleTwoContentImage.description: Layout holding a title, two content regions and an image. Set exactly one layout key.

comparison.description: Layout setting two content regions side by side for comparison. Set exactly one layout key.

blank.description: Blank layout. BlankLayout declares no fields, so send an empty object: {}.

titleSubTitleImage.description: Layout holding a title, a subtitle and an image. Set exactly one layout key.

titleFourContent.description: Layout holding a title and four content regions. Set exactly one layout key.

titleThreeContentImage.description: Layout holding a title, three content regions and an image. Set exactly one layout key.

titleSubTitle.description: Layout holding a title and a subtitle. Set exactly one layout key.

titleTwoContent.description: Layout holding a title and two content regions. Set exactly one layout key.

titleImage.description: Layout holding a title and an image. Set exactly one layout key.

titleOnly.description: Title-only layout. TitleOnlyLayout declares no fields, so send an empty object: {}.

titleContent.description: Layout holding a title and one content region. Set exactly one layout key.

titleContentImageCaption.description: Layout holding a title, a content region, and an image with a caption. Set exactly one layout key.

titleTwoContentTwoImage.description: Layout holding a title, two content regions and two images. Set exactly one layout key.

titleThreeContent.description: Layout holding a title and three content regions. Set exactly one layout key.

titleThreeContentThreeImage.description: Layout holding a title, three content regions and three images. Set exactly one layout key.

graphic_objects.description: Objects to set on the layout, such as placeholders and guides, up to 500.

background.description: New background for every slide using this layout, replacing the layout's current one and overriding the master's. no_fill clears it to nothing.

name.description: New display name for the layout, up to 500 characters.

id.description: UUID of the master layout this entry updates. Mandatory.

data.description: Operation payload; endpoint-specific schemas narrow this where available.

hsb.description: Color expressed as hue, saturation and brightness. Set exactly one of rgb, hsb or hex.

hex.description: Color expressed as a hex string such as #4A90D9. Set exactly one of rgb, hsb or hex.

rgb.description: Color expressed as red, green and blue channel values. Set exactly one of rgb, hsb or hex.

side.description: Which edge of the shape the connector meets: NORTH, EAST, SOUTH or WEST. UNKNOWN_SIDE leaves the server to pick the side that routes best. Set either side or point, never both.

marker.description: Arrowhead drawn at this end of the connector: NONE for a bare line, or OPEN, BLOCK, CLASSIC, DIAMOND or OVAL. DEF_MARKER_TYPE keeps the existing default.

shape_id.description: UUID of the shape this end of the connector attaches to.

point.description: Exact attachment spot in the shape's own coordinate space, for when a named edge is not precise enough. Set either side or point, never both.

no_fill.description: No fill. Set only one of no_fill, solid or gradient.

solid.description: Fills the area with a single flat color. Set only one of no_fill, solid or gradient.

gradient.description: Fills the area with a blend running between two or more colors. Set only one of no_fill, solid or gradient.

alpha.description: Transparency applied to whichever fill is set, from 0 for fully opaque to 1 for fully transparent.

name.description: Font family applied to the text. Must be one of the families Zoho Show bundles; any other name is rejected.

style.description: Variant of that family to use, such as Regular, Bold or Italic. Up to 100 characters.

linear.description: Start and end points of the gradient axis. Applies when type is LINEAR.

radial_angular.description: Center, spread, rotation and mirroring of the gradient. Applies when type is RADIAL or ANGULAR.

stops.description: Colors along the gradient and where each one sits, from 2 to 20 of them. At least two are required, since a gradient has to blend from one color to another. Mandatory.

type.description: Shape of the blend: LINEAR runs along a straight axis, RADIAL spreads outward from a center point, ANGULAR sweeps around one. These three are the only values the client renders.

color.description: Color the gradient takes at this stop. Mandatory.

position.description: Where this stop sits along the gradient, from 0 at the start of the axis to 1 at its end. Mandatory.

saturation.description: Intensity of the hue, from 0 for a fully desaturated gray to 1 for the pure color. Mandatory.

brightness.description: Brightness of the color, from 0 for black to 1 for the fully lit hue. Mandatory.

hue.description: Position on the color wheel in degrees, from 0 to 360, where 0 is red, 120 green and 240 blue. Mandatory.

value.description: Color written as a hex string, for example #4A90D9. Up to 20 characters. Mandatory.

rotate.description: Clockwise rotation of the object about its own center, in degrees.

top.description: Distance from the top edge of the slide to the top of the object, in pixels.

left.description: Distance from the left edge of the slide to the left of the object, in pixels.

width.description: Width of the object, in pixels.

flipv.description: Whether the object is mirrored top to bottom about its horizontal center line.

fliph.description: Whether the object is mirrored left to right about its vertical center line.

height.description: Height of the object, in pixels.

variant.description: Outer arrangement for the four-content layout, naming the direction the blocks run in and whether the title leads or trails.

outer.description: Outer arrangement of the layout, naming how the title block and the content or image block are stacked or split, and which of them leads.

type.description: How the layout's regions are arranged, naming both the direction they run in and the order they appear in, or the corner for a grid position.

inner.description: Inner arrangement within the layout's content block, naming how its parts are ordered or alternated.

order.description: Direction the grid positions are filled: GRID_ORDER_CLOCKWISE or GRID_ORDER_ANTI_CLOCKWISE.

stack.description: Arranges the layout's regions one after another along a single axis. The three arrangements are independent, and the endpoint accepts more than one being sent.

split.description: Arranges the layout's regions by splitting the slide into rows or columns. The three arrangements are independent, and the endpoint accepts more than one being sent.

grid.description: Arranges the layout's regions into grid positions. The three arrangements are independent, and the endpoint accepts more than one being sent.

start.description: Point at which the gradient axis begins, in normalized coordinates from 0 to 1 across the object's bounding box. Mandatory.

end.description: Point at which the gradient axis ends, in normalized coordinates from 0 to 1 across the object's bounding box. Mandatory.

before.description: Extra blank space held above the paragraph, on top of its line spacing.

line.description: Spacing between the lines of the paragraph, as a multiple of the line height: 1.0 is single spacing, 2.0 double.

after.description: Extra blank space held below the paragraph, on top of its line spacing.

spacing.description: Line spacing inside the paragraph and the blank space held above and below it.

level.description: Indent depth of the paragraph, counting outward from 0 for a top-level paragraph.

portion_style.description: Text styling applied to every run in the paragraph that does not override it.

halign.description: Horizontal alignment of the paragraph: LEFT, CENTER, RIGHT, or JUSTIFY to stretch its lines out to both margins.

style.description: Alignment, spacing, indent level and default text styling for this paragraph.

id.description: UUID identifying this paragraph, used to address it in later update calls. Mandatory.

portions.description: Runs of text making up the paragraph, up to 500. Each run carries its own styling, so one paragraph can mix fonts, weights and colors.

style.description: Alignment, spacing, indent level and default text styling for the paragraph being inserted.

portions.description: Runs of text making up the paragraph being inserted, up to 500. Each run carries its own styling.

x.description: Horizontal position in canvas units, measured rightward from the left edge of the viewbox.

y.description: Vertical position in canvas units, measured downward from the top edge of the viewbox.

point.description: The point this command targets, given as x and y in canvas units. Mandatory.

style.description: Styling applied to this run alone, overriding the paragraph's default style.

text.description: The literal text of this run, up to 500,000 characters. HTML markup is stripped before the text is stored.

style.description: Styling applied to the inserted run alone, overriding the paragraph's default style.

text.description: The literal text of the run being inserted, up to 500,000 characters. HTML markup is stripped before the text is stored.

fontweight.description: Stroke weight of the text, lightest to heaviest: THIN, EXTRA_LIGHT, LIGHT, NORMAL, MEDIUM, DEMI_BOLD, BOLD, HEAVY, BLACK.

size.description: Font size of this run of text, in points.

color.description: Color the text of this run is drawn in.

underline.description: Whether this run of text carries an underline.

strike.description: Whether this run of text is struck through.

italic.description: Whether this run of text is slanted.

font_name.description: Font family and variant applied to this run of text.

red.description: Red channel intensity, an integer from 0 to 255. Mandatory.

green.description: Green channel intensity, an integer from 0 to 255. Mandatory.

blue.description: Blue channel intensity, an integer from 0 to 255. Mandatory.

flip_horizontal.description: Whether to mirror the gradient left to right about its center point.

center.description: Point the gradient radiates from, in normalized coordinates from 0 to 1 across the object's bounding box. Mandatory.

spread_x.description: How far the gradient reaches horizontally from its center, as a ratio of the bounding box. Must be 0 or greater.

spread_y.description: How far the gradient reaches vertically from its center, as a ratio of the bounding box. Must be 0 or greater.

rotation_angle.description: Rotation applied to the gradient about its center point, in degrees.

flip_vertical.description: Whether to mirror the gradient top to bottom about its center point.

color.description: The single flat color painted across the whole filled area. Mandatory.

captype.description: How a border line ends: FLAT stops at the endpoint, CAPROUND adds a half-circle, SQUARE adds a half-square.

jointype.description: How two border segments meet at a corner: ROUND curves the join, BEVEL cuts it flat, MITER extends it to a sharp point.

width.description: Thickness of the border line, in pixels.

position.description: Where the border sits relative to the shape outline: CENTER straddles it, INSIDE keeps it within the shape, OUTSIDE draws it beyond the shape.

type.description: Line style of the border: SOLID for an unbroken line, DASH for dashes, SQUARE_DOT for square dots. To remove the border entirely set fill.no_fill instead of this field.

fill.description: Paint used to draw the border line. Carries either a solid color or no_fill, which turns the border off.

solid.description: Paints the border with a single flat color. Set either solid or no_fill, never both.

no_fill.description: No stroke fill — stroke-off toggle (oneof variant)

alpha.description: Opacity of the border paint, given as a ratio from 0.0 to 1.0.

paragraphs.description: Paragraphs making up the text body, in the order they read, up to 1000.

properties.description: Vertical alignment, padding, default paragraph style and auto-fit behavior for the text body as a whole.

paragraphs.description: Paragraphs making up the text body being inserted, in the order they read, up to 1000.

properties.description: Vertical alignment, padding, default paragraph style and auto-fit behavior for the inserted text body.

top.description: Space held between the top edge of the shape and its text, in pixels.

left.description: Space held between the left edge of the shape and its text, in pixels.

bottom.description: Space held between the bottom edge of the shape and its text, in pixels.

right.description: Space held between the right edge of the shape and its text, in pixels.

inset.description: Padding held between the shape's edges and its text, on each of the four sides.

auto_fit.description: How text and shape adapt when the text does not fit: NONE leaves it overflowing, TEXT shrinks the text down to the shape, SHAPE grows the shape out to the text.

valign.description: Vertical placement of the text block inside the shape: TOP, MIDDLE or BOTTOM.

para_style.description: Paragraph styling applied to every paragraph in the body that does not override it.

shape.description: The object is a shape. Set exactly one of shape, connector, group_shape or table.

callout.description: Draws a callout with a leader line or tail. Set exactly one of the seven geometry keys.

type.description: Which callout to draw: LINE for a plain leader line, or RECTANGLE_CALLOUT, ROUNDED_RECTANGLE_CALLOUT, OVAL_CALLOUT or CLOUD_CALLOUT for a speech body with a tail.

mathematical_symbol.description: Draws a mathematical operator symbol. Set exactly one of the seven geometry keys.

type.description: Which operator symbol to draw: PLUS, MINUS, MULTIPLY, DIVIDE, EQUAL or NOT_EQUAL.

star.description: Draws a star, ribbon, scroll or wave. Set exactly one of the seven geometry keys.

ribbon.description: Which ribbon form to draw. Applies when type is RIBBON.

type.description: Which ribbon form to draw: UP or DOWN for a straight ribbon, CURVED_UP or CURVED_DOWN for a curved one.

scroll.description: Which way the scroll is rolled. Applies when type is SCROLL.

type.description: Which way the scroll is rolled: VERTICAL or HORIZONTAL.
Which star or banner form to draw: EXPLOSION, POINT, RIBBON, SCROLL or WAVE. All but EXPLOSION take further settings through the sibling keys below.

point.description: How many points the star carries. Applies when type is POINT.

type.description: How many points the star carries, from FOUR_POINT up to THIRTY_TWO_POINT.

wave.description: Whether the wave carries one crest or two. Applies when type is WAVE.

type.description: Whether the wave carries one crest or two: SINGLE or DOUBLE.

custom.description: Draws a shape from explicit path commands, for geometry the built-in families do not cover. Set exactly one of the seven geometry keys.

paths.description: Paths making up the shape's geometry, from 1 to 1000. Separate paths let one shape carry disjoint outlines and enclosed holes. Mandatory.

commands.description: Ordered drawing commands tracing this path, applied in sequence from the first. Each element carries exactly one command key. Up to 5000 commands.

smooth_cubic_to.description: Draws a cubic Bezier that joins the preceding curve seamlessly: only the second control point is sent, the first being the reflection of the previous curve's trailing control point.

control2.description: Control point governing how the curve arrives at the end point. The first control point is not sent: it is inferred by reflecting the previous curve's trailing control point about the current point. Mandatory.

end.description: Point at which the curve finishes. It becomes the current point for the command that follows. Mandatory.

arc_to.description: Draws an elliptical arc from the current point to an end point, using the given radii and sweep angle.

x_radius.description: Horizontal radius, in canvas units, of the ellipse the arc is cut from.

y_radius.description: Vertical radius, in canvas units, of the ellipse the arc is cut from.

start_angle.description: Angle on that ellipse, in degrees, at which the arc begins.

sweep_angle.description: How far the arc travels from its start angle, in degrees. A negative value sweeps in the opposite direction.

end.description: Point at which the arc finishes. It becomes the current point for the command that follows. Mandatory.

move_to.description: Lifts the pen and begins a new subpath at the given point, drawing nothing on the way there.

quadratic_to.description: Draws a quadratic Bezier curve from the current point to an end point, shaped by a single control point.

control.description: The single control point that shapes the whole curve, pulling it away from the straight line between the current point and the end point. Mandatory.

end.description: Point at which the curve finishes. It becomes the current point for the command that follows. Mandatory.

line_to.description: Draws a straight line from the current point to the given point.

cubic_to.description: Draws a cubic Bezier curve from the current point to an end point, shaped by two control points.

control2.description: Second control point, which pulls the curve as it approaches the end point and sets its arrival direction. Mandatory.

control1.description: First control point, which pulls the curve as it leaves the current point and sets its departure direction. Mandatory.

end.description: Point at which the curve finishes. It becomes the current point for the command that follows. Mandatory.

smooth_quadratic_to.description: Draws a quadratic Bezier that joins the preceding curve seamlessly: no control point is sent, it is the reflection of the previous curve's control point.

end.description: Point at which the curve finishes. It becomes the current point for the command that follows. Mandatory.

width.description: Width of the coordinate viewbox the path commands are expressed in, in pixels. Must be greater than 0. Mandatory.

height.description: Height of the coordinate viewbox the path commands are expressed in, in pixels. Must be greater than 0. Mandatory.

block_arrow.description: Draws a block arrow. Set exactly one of the seven geometry keys.

double_arrow.description: Axis the two heads point along. Applies when type is DOUBLE.

type.description: Axis the two heads point along: UP_DOWN for vertical, LEFT_RIGHT for horizontal, LEFT_UP for a bent arrow with one head left and one up.

curved_arrow.description: Direction the arrow curves toward. Applies when type is CURVED.

type.description: Direction the curved arrow's head points: RIGHT, LEFT, TOP or BOTTOM.

arrow_callout.description: Direction the callout's arrow points. Applies when type is CALLOUT.

type.description: Direction the callout's arrow points: RIGHT, LEFT, TOP or BOTTOM.
Which block-arrow form to draw, from plain SINGLE and DOUBLE through BENT, U_TURN, CHEVRON and QUAD to the callout variants. Four of these take a direction through the sibling keys below.

single_arrow.description: Direction the arrow points. Applies when type is SINGLE.

type.description: Direction the arrow points: RIGHT, LEFT, TOP or BOTTOM.

flowchart.description: Draws a standard flowchart symbol. Set exactly one of the seven geometry keys.

type.description: Which standard flowchart symbol to draw, such as PROCESS, DECISION, TERMINATOR, DATA or DOCUMENT, along with the storage, connector and collation symbols.

text.description: Text held inside the shape, as paragraphs carrying their own styling.

basic.description: Draws one of the standard shapes: rectangles, ovals, polygons and similar. Set exactly one of the seven geometry keys.

snip_rectangle.description: Which corners are cut off square. Applies when type is SNIP_RECTANGLE.

type.description: Which corners are cut off square: SNIP_SINGLE snips one, SNIP_SAME_SIDE snips two along the same edge, SNIP_DIAGONAL snips two opposite corners.

rounded_rectangle.description: Which corners are rounded. Applies when type is ROUNDED_RECTANGLE.

type.description: Which corners are rounded: NORMAL rounds all four, SINGLE rounds one, SAME_SIDE rounds two along the same edge, DIAGONAL rounds two opposite corners.

bracket.description: Which bracket form to draw. Applies when type is BRACKET.

type.description: Which bracket to draw: LEFT or RIGHT for a single bracket facing that way, DOUBLE for a matching pair.

brace.description: Which brace form to draw. Applies when type is BRACE.

type.description: Which brace to draw: LEFT or RIGHT for a single brace facing that way, DOUBLE for a matching pair.

Which standard shape to draw: rectangles and ovals, regular polygons from PENTAGON to DECAGON, and decorative forms such as HEART, SUN, CLOUD or LIGHTNING_BOLT. Five of these take further settings through the sibling keys below.

triangle.description: Which triangle form to draw. Applies when type is TRIANGLE.

type.description: Which triangle to draw: ISOSCELES has two sides of equal length, RIGHT_ANGLED has one square corner.

properties.description: Position, size, fills, strokes and placeholder binding for the shape.

layout.description: Position, size, rotation and mirroring of the object on the slide.

strokes.description: Border styles drawn around the object, up to 20. Supplying this replaces any border the object would inherit from its style.

placeholder.description: Binds the object to a placeholder defined by the slide's layout, so it takes that placeholder's position and styling.

type.description: Which placeholder of the slide's layout this object fills: TITLE, SUBTITLE, CONTENT, IMAGE, CHART or TABLE. Mandatory whenever a placeholder binding is present.

fills.description: Fill styles painted into the object, up to 20. Supplying this replaces any fill the object would inherit from its style.

connector.description: The object is a connector joining two shapes. Set exactly one of shape, connector, group_shape or table.

connected.description: The two shapes the connector joins, carrying the attachment point and arrowhead for each end. Mandatory.

first.description: The shape and attachment point the connector starts from.

second.description: The shape and attachment point the connector ends at.

type.description: How the connector routes between the two shapes: LINE runs straight, ELBOW turns at right angles, CURVE bends smoothly.

stroke.description: Line style, thickness and color of the connector.

captype.description: How the connector line ends: FLAT stops at the endpoint, CAPROUND adds a half-circle, SQUARE adds a half-square.

jointype.description: How two segments of the connector meet at a turn: ROUND curves the join, BEVEL cuts it flat, MITER extends it to a sharp point.

width.description: Thickness of the connector line, in pixels.

position.description: Where the drawn line sits relative to the routed path: CENTER straddles it, INSIDE or OUTSIDE offsets it to one side.

type.description: Line style of the connector: SOLID for an unbroken line, DASH for dashes, SQUARE_DOT for square dots.

fill.description: Paint used to draw the connector line. Only a solid color is supported here, since connectors cannot be turned off with no_fill.

solid.description: Flat color the connector line is drawn in. Mandatory, as connectors support no other fill variant.

alpha.description: Opacity of the connector line's paint, given as a ratio from 0.0 to 1.0.

name.description: Display name for the object, shown in the editor's object list. Up to 500 characters.

group_shape.description: The object is a group holding other objects. Set exactly one of shape, connector, group_shape or table.

layout.description: Position, size, rotation and mirroring of the group as a whole.

objects.description: Graphic objects held inside the group, up to 500. Groups may themselves be nested.

id.description: UUID identifying the graphic object, used to address it in later calls. Mandatory.

table.description: The object is a table. Set exactly one of shape, connector, group_shape or table.

layout.description: Position, size, rotation and mirroring of the table on the slide.

columns.description: Columns of the table in left-to-right order, from 1 to 1000, each carrying its width. Mandatory.

width.description: Width of the column, in pixels. Must be 0 or greater.

style_ref.description: Reference to a saved table style, either one held in this document or a system style such as 'table.system.default'.

library.description: Reference to an asset held in a subscribed library rather than in this document. Set either local_id or library, never both.

library_id.description: Id of the subscribed library the asset is taken from, up to 200 characters. Mandatory.

asset_id.description: Id identifying the asset within that library, up to 200 characters. Mandatory.

local_id.description: Id of an asset already held in this document, such as a media object id or a system style id like 'table.system.default'. Set either local_id or library, never both.

style.description: Table style settings supplied inline. Sending this overrides whatever style_ref points at.

band_row.description: Whether alternating rows take a contrasting fill, to make long tables easier to read.

first_col.description: Whether the first column takes the style's header formatting.

band_col.description: Whether alternating columns take a contrasting fill, to make wide tables easier to read.

first_row.description: Whether the first row takes the style's header formatting.

last_row.description: Whether the last row takes the style's total-row formatting.

fill.description: Fill suggested for the table as a whole. Individual cells may override it.

stroke.description: Border suggested for the table as a whole. Individual cells may override it.

last_col.description: Whether the last column takes the style's total-column formatting.

rows.description: Rows of the table in top-to-bottom order, from 1 to 1000, each carrying its cells. Mandatory.

cells.description: Cells of the row in left-to-right order, up to 1000.

border.description: Borders drawn around the cell, overriding whatever the table style supplies.

all.description: Border applied to all four edges at once, as a shorthand for setting each of them separately.

top.description: Border drawn along the top edge of the cell.

left.description: Border drawn along the left edge of the cell.

bottom.description: Border drawn along the bottom edge of the cell.

right.description: Border drawn along the right edge of the cell.

merge_cols.description: Number of columns this cell is merged across, counting from its own position. Must be 0 or greater.

merge_rows.description: Number of rows this cell is merged across, counting from its own position. Must be 0 or greater.

text.description: Text held in the cell, as paragraphs carrying their own styling.

is_merged.description: Whether this cell forms part of a merged region rather than standing on its own.

fill.description: Fill painted behind the cell's contents, overriding whatever the table style supplies.

height.description: Height of the row, in pixels. Must be 0 or greater.

shape.description: Insert a shape. Exactly one of shape, connector, group_shape or table is required, and the object's id is generated by the server.

callout.description: Draws a callout with a leader line or tail. Exactly one of the seven geometry keys is required on an insert.

type.description: Which callout to draw: LINE for a plain leader line, or RECTANGLE_CALLOUT, ROUNDED_RECTANGLE_CALLOUT, OVAL_CALLOUT or CLOUD_CALLOUT for a speech body with a tail.

mathematical_symbol.description: Draws a mathematical operator symbol. Exactly one of the seven geometry keys is required on an insert.

type.description: Which operator symbol to draw: PLUS, MINUS, MULTIPLY, DIVIDE, EQUAL or NOT_EQUAL.

star.description: Draws a star, ribbon, scroll or wave. Exactly one of the seven geometry keys is required on an insert.

ribbon.description: Which ribbon form to draw. Applies when type is RIBBON.

type.description: Which ribbon form to draw: UP or DOWN for a straight ribbon, CURVED_UP or CURVED_DOWN for a curved one.

scroll.description: Which way the scroll is rolled. Applies when type is SCROLL.

type.description: Which way the scroll is rolled: VERTICAL or HORIZONTAL.
Which star or banner form to draw: EXPLOSION, POINT, RIBBON, SCROLL or WAVE. All but EXPLOSION take further settings through the sibling keys below.

point.description: How many points the star carries. Applies when type is POINT.

type.description: How many points the star carries, from FOUR_POINT up to THIRTY_TWO_POINT.

wave.description: Whether the wave carries one crest or two. Applies when type is WAVE.

type.description: Whether the wave carries one crest or two: SINGLE or DOUBLE.

custom.description: Draws a shape from explicit path commands, for geometry the built-in families do not cover. Exactly one of the seven geometry keys is required on an insert.

paths.description: Paths making up the shape's geometry, from 1 to 1000. Separate paths let one shape carry disjoint outlines and enclosed holes. Mandatory.

commands.description: Ordered drawing commands tracing this path, applied in sequence from the first. Each element carries exactly one command key. Up to 5000 commands.

smooth_cubic_to.description: Draws a cubic Bezier that joins the preceding curve seamlessly: only the second control point is sent, the first being the reflection of the previous curve's trailing control point.

control2.description: Control point governing how the curve arrives at the end point. The first control point is not sent: it is inferred by reflecting the previous curve's trailing control point about the current point. Mandatory.

end.description: Point at which the curve finishes. It becomes the current point for the command that follows. Mandatory.

arc_to.description: Draws an elliptical arc from the current point to an end point, using the given radii and sweep angle.

x_radius.description: Horizontal radius, in canvas units, of the ellipse the arc is cut from.

y_radius.description: Vertical radius, in canvas units, of the ellipse the arc is cut from.

start_angle.description: Angle on that ellipse, in degrees, at which the arc begins.

sweep_angle.description: How far the arc travels from its start angle, in degrees. A negative value sweeps in the opposite direction.

end.description: Point at which the arc finishes. It becomes the current point for the command that follows. Mandatory.

move_to.description: Lifts the pen and begins a new subpath at the given point, drawing nothing on the way there.

quadratic_to.description: Draws a quadratic Bezier curve from the current point to an end point, shaped by a single control point.

control.description: The single control point that shapes the whole curve, pulling it away from the straight line between the current point and the end point. Mandatory.

end.description: Point at which the curve finishes. It becomes the current point for the command that follows. Mandatory.

line_to.description: Draws a straight line from the current point to the given point.

cubic_to.description: Draws a cubic Bezier curve from the current point to an end point, shaped by two control points.

control2.description: Second control point, which pulls the curve as it approaches the end point and sets its arrival direction. Mandatory.

control1.description: First control point, which pulls the curve as it leaves the current point and sets its departure direction. Mandatory.

end.description: Point at which the curve finishes. It becomes the current point for the command that follows. Mandatory.

smooth_quadratic_to.description: Draws a quadratic Bezier that joins the preceding curve seamlessly: no control point is sent, it is the reflection of the previous curve's control point.

end.description: Point at which the curve finishes. It becomes the current point for the command that follows. Mandatory.

width.description: Width of the coordinate viewbox the path commands are expressed in, in pixels. Must be greater than 0. Mandatory.

height.description: Height of the coordinate viewbox the path commands are expressed in, in pixels. Must be greater than 0. Mandatory.

block_arrow.description: Draws a block arrow. Exactly one of the seven geometry keys is required on an insert.

double_arrow.description: Axis the two heads point along. Applies when type is DOUBLE.

type.description: Axis the two heads point along: UP_DOWN for vertical, LEFT_RIGHT for horizontal, LEFT_UP for a bent arrow with one head left and one up.

curved_arrow.description: Direction the arrow curves toward. Applies when type is CURVED.

type.description: Direction the curved arrow's head points: RIGHT, LEFT, TOP or BOTTOM.

arrow_callout.description: Direction the callout's arrow points. Applies when type is CALLOUT.

type.description: Direction the callout's arrow points: RIGHT, LEFT, TOP or BOTTOM.
Which block-arrow form to draw, from plain SINGLE and DOUBLE through BENT, U_TURN, CHEVRON and QUAD to the callout variants. Four of these take a direction through the sibling keys below.

single_arrow.description: Direction the arrow points. Applies when type is SINGLE.

type.description: Direction the arrow points: RIGHT, LEFT, TOP or BOTTOM.

flowchart.description: Draws a standard flowchart symbol. Exactly one of the seven geometry keys is required on an insert.

type.description: Which standard flowchart symbol to draw, such as PROCESS, DECISION, TERMINATOR, DATA or DOCUMENT, along with the storage, connector and collation symbols.

text.description: Text to place inside the new shape, as paragraphs carrying their own styling.

basic.description: Draws one of the standard shapes: rectangles, ovals, polygons and similar. Exactly one of the seven geometry keys is required on an insert.

snip_rectangle.description: Which corners are cut off square. Applies when type is SNIP_RECTANGLE.

type.description: Which corners are cut off square: SNIP_SINGLE snips one, SNIP_SAME_SIDE snips two along the same edge, SNIP_DIAGONAL snips two opposite corners.

rounded_rectangle.description: Which corners are rounded. Applies when type is ROUNDED_RECTANGLE.

type.description: Which corners are rounded: NORMAL rounds all four, SINGLE rounds one, SAME_SIDE rounds two along the same edge, DIAGONAL rounds two opposite corners.

bracket.description: Which bracket form to draw. Applies when type is BRACKET.

type.description: Which bracket to draw: LEFT or RIGHT for a single bracket facing that way, DOUBLE for a matching pair.

brace.description: Which brace form to draw. Applies when type is BRACE.

type.description: Which brace to draw: LEFT or RIGHT for a single brace facing that way, DOUBLE for a matching pair.

Which standard shape to draw: rectangles and ovals, regular polygons from PENTAGON to DECAGON, and decorative forms such as HEART, SUN, CLOUD or LIGHTNING_BOLT. Five of these take further settings through the sibling keys below.

triangle.description: Which triangle form to draw. Applies when type is TRIANGLE.

type.description: Which triangle to draw: ISOSCELES has two sides of equal length, RIGHT_ANGLED has one square corner.

properties.description: Position, size, fills, strokes and placeholder binding for the new shape.

layout.description: Position, size, rotation and mirroring of the object on the slide.

strokes.description: Border styles drawn around the object, up to 20. Supplying this replaces any border the object would inherit from its style.

placeholder.description: Binds the object to a placeholder defined by the slide's layout, so it takes that placeholder's position and styling.

type.description: Which placeholder of the slide's layout this object fills: TITLE, SUBTITLE, CONTENT, IMAGE, CHART or TABLE. Mandatory whenever a placeholder binding is present.

fills.description: Fill styles painted into the object, up to 20. Supplying this replaces any fill the object would inherit from its style.

connector.description: Insert a connector joining two shapes. Exactly one of shape, connector, group_shape or table is required, and the object's id is generated by the server.

connected.description: The two shapes the new connector joins, carrying the attachment point and arrowhead for each end. Mandatory.

first.description: The shape and attachment point the connector starts from.

second.description: The shape and attachment point the connector ends at.

type.description: How the new connector routes between the two shapes: LINE runs straight, ELBOW turns at right angles, CURVE bends smoothly.

stroke.description: Line style, thickness and color of the new connector.

captype.description: How the connector line ends: FLAT stops at the endpoint, CAPROUND adds a half-circle, SQUARE adds a half-square.

jointype.description: How two segments of the connector meet at a turn: ROUND curves the join, BEVEL cuts it flat, MITER extends it to a sharp point.

width.description: Thickness of the connector line, in pixels.

position.description: Where the drawn line sits relative to the routed path: CENTER straddles it, INSIDE or OUTSIDE offsets it to one side.

type.description: Line style of the connector: SOLID for an unbroken line, DASH for dashes, SQUARE_DOT for square dots.

fill.description: Paint used to draw the connector line. Only a solid color is supported here, since connectors cannot be turned off with no_fill.

solid.description: Flat color the connector line is drawn in. Mandatory, as connectors support no other fill variant.

alpha.description: Opacity of the connector line's paint, given as a ratio from 0.0 to 1.0.

name.description: Display name for the new object, shown in the editor's object list. Up to 500 characters.

group_shape.description: Insert a group holding other objects. Exactly one of shape, connector, group_shape or table is required, and the object's id is generated by the server.

layout.description: Position, size, rotation and mirroring of the new group as a whole.

objects.description: Graphic objects to place inside the new group, up to 500. Groups may themselves be nested.

table.description: Insert a table. Exactly one of shape, connector, group_shape or table is required, and the object's id is generated by the server.

layout.description: Position, size, rotation and mirroring of the new table on the slide.

columns.description: Columns of the new table in left-to-right order, from 1 to 1000, each carrying its width. Mandatory.

width.description: Width of the column, in pixels. Must be 0 or greater.

style_ref.description: Reference to a saved table style, either one held in this document or a system style such as 'table.system.default'.

library.description: Reference to an asset held in a subscribed library rather than in this document. Set either local_id or library, never both.

library_id.description: Id of the subscribed library the asset is taken from, up to 200 characters. Mandatory.

asset_id.description: Id identifying the asset within that library, up to 200 characters. Mandatory.

local_id.description: Id of an asset already held in this document, such as a media object id or a system style id like 'table.system.default'. Set either local_id or library, never both.

style.description: Table style settings supplied inline. Sending this overrides whatever style_ref points at.

band_row.description: Whether alternating rows take a contrasting fill, to make long tables easier to read.

first_col.description: Whether the first column takes the style's header formatting.

band_col.description: Whether alternating columns take a contrasting fill, to make wide tables easier to read.

first_row.description: Whether the first row takes the style's header formatting.

last_row.description: Whether the last row takes the style's total-row formatting.

fill.description: Fill suggested for the table as a whole. Individual cells may override it.

stroke.description: Border suggested for the table as a whole. Individual cells may override it.

last_col.description: Whether the last column takes the style's total-column formatting.

rows.description: Rows of the new table in top-to-bottom order, from 1 to 1000, each carrying its cells. Mandatory.

cells.description: Cells of the new row in left-to-right order, up to 1000.

border.description: Borders drawn around the cell, overriding whatever the table style supplies.

all.description: Border applied to all four edges at once, as a shorthand for setting each of them separately.

top.description: Border drawn along the top edge of the cell.

left.description: Border drawn along the left edge of the cell.

bottom.description: Border drawn along the bottom edge of the cell.

right.description: Border drawn along the right edge of the cell.

merge_cols.description: Number of columns this cell is merged across, counting from its own position. Must be 0 or greater.

merge_rows.description: Number of rows this cell is merged across, counting from its own position. Must be 0 or greater.

text.description: Text to place in the cell, as paragraphs carrying their own styling.

is_merged.description: Whether this cell forms part of a merged region rather than standing on its own.

fill.description: Fill painted behind the cell's contents, overriding whatever the table style supplies.

height.description: Height of the new row, in pixels. Must be 0 or greater.
